full_judgment: 18. It is a settled proposition of law that there is a presumption of constitutionality in favour of the impugned Act No. 1 of 2003. In that view of the matter, the onus is upon the petitioner to show that the Act No. 1 of 2003 is void and ultra vires the Constitution. We will see presently how far Dr. Shahdeen Malik has succeeded in discharging this onus to our satisfaction.
